decisions.reason: Sole crash is plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call (undefined on alpha.2, replaced by useSessionStatus; useSessions kept); B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; single root cause.

Render-tree cited: one shared DrawerErrorBoundary wraps the whole input.dock list, throw unmounts entire subtree including B's chips; input.left button survives under its separate boundary, corroborated by slot logs.

Disabling A proves necessity/sufficiency of A's render crash for dock blackout and that B renders when freed; explicitly not proof of B's full alpha.2 health nor that A is the only defect; reinstalling B useless; two-prop colleague theory falsified.

Picks the pending seat the host supplies (useSessionStatus → pendingInteraction on alpha.2), typeof-probes before calling, stable EMPTY_PENDING fallback; only attention cue degrades while running/todos/token/ETA survive; silent-degradation rationale tied to shared-boundary blast radius.

Client-half change effective via hard refresh without host restart (cited hygiene rule); both entries must mount together; B regression includes paste/remove/re-paste with A enabled plus co-tenant isolation test; tenant-local boundaries and host per-entry boundary trade-off covered.

caps.reason: Final remedy targets plugin A's component; B fix/reinstall explicitly rejected; symptoms attributed to one shared-boundary cause.
